summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the engine-free plot_2d_or_3d_image function, and refactored the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers to delegate to them. Updated in-repo callers (two unet evaluation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py) to output_dir, and updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only: flake8 and the pytorch-ignite 0.3.0 event-handler registration (has_event_handler with a bound method) are unverified.
